title: Full cochain-unit normalization of the canonical exact restriction square
statement: Let F:C→D and G:C′→D′ be additive functors between abelian categories with chosen derived categories. Let R:C→C′ and S:D→D′ be exact additive functors, with R preserving K-injectives and with K-injective resolutions in the two source categories. For an ordinary natural isomorphism e:F⋙S≅R⋙G, form the canonical right-derived square by the exact/right-derived composition comparison, right derivation of e, the R/G composition comparison and identification of the right derived functor of R with its exact derived functor. On every cochain complex, this square intertwines the full canonical cochain units: S applied to the F-unit, followed by the square and the G-image of the R-factor, equals the S-factor followed by Q applied to the degreewise e and then the G-unit. No K-injectivity is assumed of this complex.

source.place: paragraph (2), the bounded filtered-colimit comparison on a single shifted rational line

proof.text: Expand the exact/right-derived composition comparison and the right-derived natural isomorphism. Cancel the inverse exact-functor comparison and use their defining factorization equations to obtain the normalized square on the homotopy category.

Evaluate on the quotient of the cochain complex. The quotient comparison components are identities. The exact-functor factor comparison gives the cochain factor on the nose, and the corresponding inverse components agree by uniqueness of inverses. Thus replace both homotopy units by the full cochain units.

Postcompose by the image of the direct exact-functor factor. Functoriality and the inverse/direct factor identity cancel the last factors, giving exactly the displayed cochain-unit equation for every complex.

theorem rightDerivedExactRestriction_normalization (F : C ⥤ D) (G : C' ⥤ D')
    (R : C ⥤ C') (S : D ⥤ D') [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [R.Additive] [S.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits R] [PreservesFiniteColimits R]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits S] [PreservesFiniteColimits S]
    [R.PreservesKInjectiveComplexes] (e : F ⋙ S ≅ R ⋙ G)
    (P : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    S.mapDerivedCategory.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ P) ≫
        ((Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso F S).symm ≪≫
          Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatIso e ≪≫ Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso R G ≪≫
          Functor.isoWhiskerRight R.rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory
            G.rightDerivedFunctor).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        G.rightDerivedFunctor.map (R.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) =
      S.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex e.hom (.up ℤ)).app P) ≫
        G.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
